skill.summary: 基于FunASR实现的中文实时会议语音转录，支持自动标点、转录保存、环境检测和文件管理。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Meeting Transcriber skill
- Real-time Chinese speech recognition and transcription using FunASR
- Includes voice activity detection, automatic punctuation, and timestamped meeting notes
- Supports file export, integrated environment checks, and one-click Conda setup
- Accessible via commands for transcribing, file management, and environment configuration within OpenClaw
